ns2:course.label: Span for Heritage Speakers II
ns2:course.description: Review at the intermediate level of Spanish orthography, syntax, and vocabulary for students of Hispanic background who have little or no formal training in the Spanish language, and an introduction to the study of U.S. Hispanic minority literature. This course fulfills the Liberal Arts and Sciences foreign language requirement. Students may receive a total of 4 hours of credit for SPAN 140, SPAN 141, SPAN 142, and SPAN 143. Prerequisite: SPAN 125 or consent of instructor.
